title: When Models Outthink Their Safety: Unveiling and Mitigating Self-Jailbreak in Large Reasoning Models
reasoning: The paper's central theme is AI safety, which is an ethical concern. It investigates why Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) generate harmful content even after identifying a query as harmful, a phenomenon termed 'Self-Jailbreak'. It proposes a framework to mitigate these ethical failures and align models with human values. The analysis involves evaluating models on their ability to refuse to perform harmful actions, which is an ethical evaluation. For instance, an example in the appendix (Figure 12) presents an explicit ethical dilemma about using a racial slur to disarm a bomb.
